summary_en: ¥14.00/share (¥12.00 ordinary + ¥2.00 40th anniversary special) for FY2026/9 (up from ¥12.00 previously). Increase of ¥2.00 per share. Non-recurring special dividend component tied to 40th founding anniversary and ValueCreation700 enterprise value program.
title_en: Notice of Modification of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Needs Well Inc. modified its dividend forecast for fiscal year ending September 2026 at a board meeting on 15 June 2026. The company raised its full-year dividend per share from ¥12.00 to ¥14.00, comprising ¥12.00 ordinary dividend and ¥2.00 special 40th anniversary commemorative dividend. The increase reflects gratitude to shareholders for their long-term support and signals management commitment to the ValueCreation700 enterprise value program, which aims at sustained growth and enhanced capital efficiency. The company framed the increase not as a one-time gesture but as evidence of confidence in future earnings stability supported by high end-user business ratios, stock-based recurring revenue, and AI-driven productivity improvements. The special dividend will be paid at the fiscal year-end (September 2026).
